how_this_signature_was_given: The maintainer was shown the trade-off between three candidate crops, told that moving the domain would void the signature already given, and chose the middle option in their own words. This records that act on the amended terms. Code did not sign this catalogue; it recorded a signature the maintainer gave, bound to the amended design's digest so the terms signed cannot drift from the terms recorded.
what_is_signed: That IBTrACS v04r01, South Pacific subset, at sha256 631f76b95c77a6a4e409233466a0d501bb4848324e421fc58e228efea2086c44, is admitted as external_reference evidence for the identity target kind_recurrence, on exactly the terms the amended design states and no others.
what_the_signature_makes_true: kind_recurrence becomes evaluable from the tool for the first time. Its admissible evidence is external_reference alone, no such evidence has existed in this programme, and the primary scientific target has therefore been unevaluable throughout -- through T4E.7 to T4E.16, seven measured criteria and one withdrawn.

the_terms_signed_are_the_AMENDED_terms.population_whole_box: 252 observations with a catalogue radius, from 21 storms, NATURE base rate 0.668
the_terms_signed_are_the_AMENDED_terms.population_interior: 176 observations from 18 storms, NATURE base rate 0.571 -- the population an identity criterion can actually use
the_terms_signed_are_the_AMENDED_terms.characterisation_only: USA_SSHS at 0.225 over the whole box, which adjudicates nothing
the_terms_signed_are_the_AMENDED_terms.radius: per observation, median 15.3 km, unchanged in rule
the_terms_signed_are_the_AMENDED_terms.the_superseded_figures_stay_visible: The pre-amendment population -- 176 observations, 18 storms, base rate 0.571 over the OLD crop -- is retained in the design. It coincides numerically with the new INTERIOR population and is a different population; the match is a coincidence and not continuity between them.

what_this_signature_does_NOT_do: It evaluates no criterion. No identity rule is declared, adopted or measured by signing a catalogue, and a criterion for this evidence needs its own declaration written before these base rates shape it.
It transfers nothing from the synthetic sequence. Candidate 2's k = S is meaningless on storm observations, and the specificity problem that shaped seven candidates is largely absent here.
It does not open the 2022-2023 forecast-test period. The catalogue's 13 in-box storms there were counted from the catalogue and remain unmatched against any frame.
It approves no mining radius, discharges no part of T4E.8's acquired-record acceptance, and closes none of D96, D97, D98, D99 or D100.
It does not make the catalogue physics. The labels are the contributing agencies' operational judgements, reviewed post-season; a criterion agreeing with them has agreed with those judgements.
the_ceiling_the_maintainer_signed_with_o: Eighteen storms, one basin, one 40-degree box, four years, and a kind label of six values two of which are refusals. That is the honest ceiling and no amount of pair-counting changes it: there are 10,721 cross-storm pairs but the unit of independence is the storm. A criterion that succeeds here succeeds on a small, real, externally-labelled population -- categorically better evidence than the synthetic sequence produced, and still small.
obligations_this_signature_creates: The publisher's citation requirement is binding: Gahtan et al. (2024), DOI 10.25921/82ty-9e16, together with Knapp et al. (2010), BAMS 91, 363-376.
The catalogue file is never committed. It is bound by its digest, and a re-download that fails to reproduce 631f76b9... invalidates any evaluation built on it, which must then say so.
Every rate reported against this evidence carries a storm-clustered interval. An interval computed as though the pairs were independent is wrong and may not be published.
Only the two-sided error rates may be reported. Accuracy is meaningless at a base rate of 0.571.
governing: Code does not sign catalogues, events or scientific preregistrations for a person. This file records the maintainer's act; it does not perform it.
Never commit the catalogue; bind it by its content identity.
Already inspected data do not become untouched by renaming them. The 2018-2021 catalogue window is development evidence from 2026-09-10.
R19: this evidence is atmospheric, and cross-domain use of anything built on it needs its own declared experiment.
claim_boundary: A signed catalogue is evidence, not a result. No frame of the 2022-2023 forecast-test period is opened by this signature.

superseded_signature.why_superseded: It was given on terms naming the crop latitude -60 to -20. T4E.18's probe showed that crop cannot support the evaluation, the maintainer chose to move it, and a different domain is a different evidence base. The signature is RE-GIVEN rather than carried over.
